tagline.en: St. Louis to the Chesapeake, finished last in West Virginia
tagline.zh: 从圣路易斯到切萨皮克，最后一段在西弗吉尼亚

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.en: I-70, US 40 and US 61 in Wentzville, Missouri
start.zh: 密苏里州温茨维尔，与 I-70、US 40、US 61 相接

end.en: I-264 and I-664 at Bowers Hill in Chesapeake, Virginia
end.zh: 弗吉尼亚州切萨皮克鲍尔斯山，与 I-264、I-664 相接

en: I-64 runs from the edge of the St. Louis suburbs to tidewater Virginia, crossing six states and three quite different landscapes on the way: the flat farm country of Illinois and southern Indiana, the Kentucky and West Virginia mountains, and the Virginia Piedmont and coastal plain.

It is more fragmentary in feel than most long Interstates because it shares pavement so often. It runs with I-57 at Mount Vernon, with the West Virginia Turnpike and I-77 between Beckley and Charleston, with I-81 for thirty miles between Lexington and Staunton, and with I-95 through Richmond. The tolled section in West Virginia is the only part of I-64 where drivers pay.

The eastern end is the most distinctive stretch in the system's mid-Atlantic. Beyond Williamsburg the road crosses Hampton Roads through a bridge-tunnel, surfaces in Norfolk, clips Virginia Beach and then doubles back west along the Hampton Roads Beltway to end in Chesapeake.
zh: I-64 自圣路易斯郊区边缘通往弗吉尼亚的潮水地带，途中穿越六个州和三种颇为不同的地貌：伊利诺伊与印第安纳南部平坦的农田、肯塔基与西弗吉尼亚的山地，以及弗吉尼亚的皮德蒙特与海岸平原。
比起多数长距离州际公路，它给人的感觉更零碎，因为它太常与别的路共用路面：在弗农山与 I-57 共线，在贝克利至查尔斯顿之间与西弗吉尼亚收费公路及 I-77 共线，在列克星敦至斯汤顿之间与 I-81 共线三十英里，在里士满与 I-95 共线。西弗吉尼亚的收费段是 I-64 上唯一需要付费的部分。
东端是整个中大西洋地区最有特色的一段。过了威廉斯堡，道路经桥隧组合穿越汉普顿锚地，在诺福克重见天日，擦过弗吉尼亚海滩，再沿汉普顿锚地环路折返向西，终止于切萨皮克。

en: Virginia built its 267-mile share in pieces through the 1960s and 1970s and finished well ahead of the rest. A long stretch between Gum Spring and Yancey Mills, west of Charlottesville, opened in a single day in September 1970 — the longest single Interstate opening in the state's history. The road was pushed over Afton Mountain to I-81 at Staunton in 1971 and 1972, around Lexington in 1976, and the last Virginia link, from Clifton Forge to Longdale Furnace, opened on 29 June 1979.

West Virginia took another nine years, because the route had to be argued about first. The original plan followed US 60 east of Charleston through the mountains; in 1974 the governor settled on a different line, running west from Sam Black Church to meet the West Virginia Turnpike near Beckley and then sharing the rebuilt turnpike north. That last segment opened on 15 July 1988, completing I-64 from St. Louis to Hampton Roads.

Missouri was still finishing in the twenty-first century. Its section had been the Daniel Boone Expressway and then simply US 40, designated I-64 in 1988 but not built and signed continuously to I-70 at Wentzville until December 2009.
zh: 弗吉尼亚起步最早，完工也早。该州第一段 I-64 于 1958 年沿里士满—彼得斯堡收费公路通车；1970 年 9 月，里士满以西 52 英里路段一天之内全部开放，是弗吉尼亚州际公路系统单次通车里程之最；本州最后一段自克利夫顿福奇至朗代尔弗内斯，于 1979 年 6 月 29 日通车。
西弗吉尼亚又花了九年，因为线位本身先得吵一架。最初方案是在查尔斯顿以东沿 US 60 翻山而行；1974 年，州长敲定了另一条线：自萨姆·布莱克教堂向西，在贝克利附近接上西弗吉尼亚收费公路，再借重建后的收费公路北行。最后这一段于 1988 年 7 月 15 日通车，I-64 自圣路易斯至汉普顿锚地全线贯通。
密苏里直到二十一世纪还在收尾。该州路段曾名「丹尼尔·布恩快速路」，后来只叫 US 40，1988 年被指定为 I-64，但直到 2009 年 12 月才连续建成并挂牌通到温茨维尔的 I-70。

en: Two projects on I-64 stand out in cost, and they sit at opposite ends of the route and of the century. The last rural link in West Virginia was one of the most expensive stretches of rural Interstate ever built in the United States, because it crosses thirty-odd miles of extremely rugged country with no existing four-lane road to work from. The same programme rebuilt the two-lane West Virginia Turnpike to Interstate standard, and the state kept the tolls.

At the eastern end, the Hampton Roads Bridge-Tunnel Expansion is the largest highway construction project in Virginia's history. It adds twin two-lane bored tunnels under the harbour and widens roughly ten miles of the corridor, and it is funded overwhelmingly by a regional authority rather than out of the state's general highway programme.
No total exists for the route itself. Six states built it across five decades, and federal cost records were organised by state and fiscal year.
zh: I-64 上有两项工程在造价上格外突出，它们分处路线的两端，也分属不同的世纪。西弗吉尼亚最后那段乡村连接线，是美国有史以来造价最高的乡村州际公路路段之一，因为它要穿越三十多英里极为崎岖的地区，且没有既有四车道道路可资利用。同一批计划还把双车道的西弗吉尼亚收费公路改建至州际公路标准，而该州保留了收费。
在东端，汉普顿锚地桥隧扩建工程是弗吉尼亚州历史上最大的公路建设项目。它在港湾之下新增一对双车道盾构隧道，并把约十英里的走廊拓宽；其资金绝大部分来自一个区域性机构，而非州级公路计划。
整条路线本身没有总造价。六个州历时五十年把它建成，而联邦造价记录是按州和财政年度组织的。

why.en: No public figure exists. Six states built the route between 1958 and 1988, one long section was an existing bond-financed toll road rebuilt with Interstate money, and federal cost accounting was organised by state and fiscal year rather than by route.
why.zh: 无公开数据。六个州于 1958 至 1988 年间建成本路线，其中很长一段是用州际公路资金改建的既有债券融资收费公路；联邦造价核算按州和财政年度而非按路线组织。

value.en: 867.25 miles across 6 states; longest in Virginia at 267.31 miles, shortest in Missouri at 40.59
value.zh: 867.25 英里，横跨 6 个州；弗吉尼亚州最长，267.31 英里；密苏里州最短，40.59 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

label.en: Last segment, Beckley to Sam Black Church
label.zh: 最后一段：贝克利至萨姆·布莱克教堂

value.en: $313.5 million for 36 miles, opened 15 July 1988 after about twenty years of delay
value.zh: 36 英里造价 3.135 亿美元，历经约二十年延宕后于 1988 年 7 月 15 日通车

label.en: Gum Spring to Yancey Mills section, 1970
label.zh: 1970 年格姆斯普林至扬西米尔斯路段

value.en: More than $70 million for 52 miles; on opening it brought Virginia's completed share of the 267-mile route to 173 miles
value.zh: 52 英里造价逾 7,000 万美元；通车后，弗吉尼亚 267 英里路段已建成 173 英里

figures.source: Virginia Department of Highways, Virginia Highway Bulletin, August 1970

label.zh: 1971 年阿夫顿山至 I-81 路段

value.zh: 12.6 英里造价 2,500 万美元，9 月 1 日通车

figures.source: Virginia Department of Highways, Virginia Highway Bulletin, 1971

label.zh: 汉普顿锚地桥隧扩建工程

value.en: Total project budget of $3,935,451,641, with $2.878 billion spent through 23 August 2025; substantial completion due 26 February 2027
value.zh: 项目总预算 3,935,451,641 美元，截至 2025 年 8 月 23 日已支出 28.78 亿美元；预定 2027 年 2 月 26 日实质竣工

figures.source: Hampton Roads Bridge-Tunnel Expansion monthly project report, August 2025

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. Counts are collected per segment by six state transportation departments, and on the long overlaps with I-57, I-77, I-81 and I-95 they cannot be attributed to I-64 alone.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。交通量由六个州的交通部门按路段采集，而在与 I-57、I-77、I-81、I-95 的长距离共线段上，这些数据无法单独归于 I-64。

value.en: Nearly three million vehicles a month, and more than 100,000 a day during the tourist season
value.zh: 每月近 300 万辆，旅游旺季日均超过 100,000 辆

trafficFigures.source: Virginia Department of Transportation, Hampton Roads bridges and tunnels

timeline.en: The first two-lane Hampton Roads Bridge-Tunnel opens on 1 November, years before I-64 reaches it.
timeline.zh: 11 月 1 日，第一条双车道汉普顿锚地桥隧通车，比 I-64 修抵此处早了许多年。

timeline.en: A 52-mile section from Gum Spring to Yancey Mills opens on 25 September — the longest single Interstate opening in Virginia.
timeline.zh: 9 月 25 日，自格姆斯普林至扬西米尔斯的 52 英里路段一次性通车，是弗吉尼亚州际公路单次通车里程之最。

timeline.en: West Virginia's governor settles the route east of Charleston, choosing a line from Sam Black Church west to the turnpike near Beckley.
timeline.zh: 西弗吉尼亚州长敲定查尔斯顿以东的线位，选择自萨姆·布莱克教堂西行、于贝克利附近接入收费公路的方案。

timeline.en: A parallel two-lane Hampton Roads Bridge-Tunnel opens, completing an Interstate route through Hampton Roads for the first time.
timeline.zh: 第二条平行的双车道汉普顿锚地桥隧通车，州际公路首次贯通汉普顿锚地地区。

timeline.en: Virginia completes its section on 29 June with the link from Clifton Forge to Longdale Furnace.
timeline.zh: 6 月 29 日，随着克利夫顿福奇至朗代尔弗内斯的连接段建成，弗吉尼亚段全部完工。

timeline.en: The last segment opens in West Virginia on 15 July, completing I-64 from St. Louis to Hampton Roads; Missouri designates its US 40 corridor as I-64 the same year.
timeline.zh: 7 月 15 日西弗吉尼亚最后一段通车，I-64 自圣路易斯至汉普顿锚地全线贯通；同年密苏里将其 US 40 走廊指定为 I-64。

timeline.en: Missouri completes and signs I-64 continuously west to I-70 at Wentzville on 6 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 6 日，密苏里将 I-64 连续建成并挂牌，一路西至温茨维尔的 I-70。

timeline.en: Construction begins in October on the Hampton Roads Bridge-Tunnel Expansion, the largest infrastructure project in Virginia's history.
timeline.zh: 10 月，弗吉尼亚州历史上最大的基础设施项目——汉普顿锚地桥隧扩建工程开工。
